what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Armenia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1211 Syrian refugees in Armenia, 0.0% of all refugees from Syria.
Türkiye hosts the most Syrian refugees, followed by Germany, Lebanon and Jordan.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria in every year from 2011 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Syria from 2013 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2011 at 6 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 16611, at the end of 2015; the main years of displacement in the data are 2013 to 2020.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Armenia.
These are year-end totals for Armenia only, reported to UNHCR.
